problem_type: A file listing that grows with the repository was capped by a hidden default buffer, and a failed listing read as an empty one
symptom: Once the tracked file list passed 1 MiB, CI Contracts went red on check:root-cause-contracts, check:main-guard, check:mcp-operation-constructible, check:model-face-frozen and check:verb-host-conformance with spawnSync git ENOBUFS, while check:secrets printed that it scanned 0 tracked files and passed.
direct_cause: gitPaths passed maxBuffer only when a caller supplied it, so most callers got the Node default of 1 MiB. The output of git ls-files -z reached 1,051,294 bytes; check-no-secrets caught the error and returned an empty list.
class_root: How long a path listing is depends on the repository, but the limit was left to each caller, so an unrelated default became a repository size limit. Nothing separated a listing that failed from a listing that is empty. The 2026-09-17 occurrence was fixed only in the one gate that hit it.
affected_population: Every pull request and local push once the list passes 1 MiB; main had 351 bytes left when this was found
The public repository, because the secrets scan passed without reading a file
entry_points: Every gate that lists files through gitPaths, gitNameStatus or trackedFiles
Four gates that started git ls-files directly: machine symlinks, NUL bytes, related tests, gates test selection
check:secrets in --all mode and staged mode
internal_only_reason: The invariant is about this repository's own gate scripts. The limit and the failure were measured directly: the byte count of the listing and the ENOBUFS error in CI and locally.
invariants: gitPaths and gitNameStatus read a listing of any realistic length, and a caller cannot lower the limit
JavaScript under scripts/ lists files with ls-files only through gitPaths or trackedFiles
check:secrets is red when it cannot list files, and red when --all lists none

door_reduction.why_not: The 30 callers stay because each gate reads its own file set. They no longer own the limit: it is one constant inside gitPaths. The four direct callers moved behind it.

generality_proof: Every listing now passes through one function with one limit and no caller option, so no caller or future gate can run with a smaller buffer, and check:git-path-quoting rejects a new direct ls-files. Reproduced at more than 1 MiB with a real git index in the boundary test.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Owns the only listing buffer limit; callers cannot pass one.
Applies the same limit to name-status listings.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Went red with ENOBUFS in CI; calls gitPaths, which now owns the limit.
Went red with ENOBUFS in CI; calls gitPaths, which now owns the limit.
Hit this on 2026-09-17 and carried its own limit; now calls gitPaths and the private limit is gone.
Carried a private 64 MiB limit; now calls gitPaths.
Listed test files without -z through its own wrapper; now calls gitPaths.
Listed untracked files with the default buffer; now calls gitPaths.
Uses ls-tree limited to named prefixes and has its own 64 MiB limit, because it needs the object ids that gitPaths does not parse.

recurrence.reason: The repository keeps growing and the same limit was already hit once on 2026-09-17, so any caller left with its own limit would hit it again.
same_class_scan: git grep for ls-files, ls-tree, --name-only and --name-status across scripts, excluding tests
git grep for gitPaths, gitNameStatus and trackedFiles followed by catch within four lines, read each one

prevention.invariant: One limit, owned by the listing entry, that callers cannot change.
prevention.failure_mode: A listing that still fails throws. check:secrets exits 1 and says it did not scan.
prevention.strategy: Remove the caller option so a small limit cannot be written, move direct callers behind the entry, and let the existing path gate reject new direct calls.

legacy_paths.rationale: The maxBuffer option and the private limits in the direct callers are gone. Callers that passed the option no longer do.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The Node default is documented behaviour and stays as it is; the repository now states its own limit at one place.

migration: None. These scripts hold no stored state.
residual_risks: Other git commands with their own wrappers and the default buffer remain, such as the commit history read in scripts/fix-churn.mjs; their output depends on the size of a change or a time window, not the whole repository. Checked by reading, not by a test.
Other gates that catch a listing error and continue were read and left alone: the limit can no longer cause that error, but a broken repository still could.
